name: Meta Ads — 24/7 Customer Acquisition Engine
description: CRITICAL: Continuous Meta ads management for new customer acquisition. Company relies on this for business growth. TRADER MINDSET REQUIRED: Think like stock market trader - 'How much to invest for maximum qualified leads within budget?' 'How to improve ROAS?' 'How to find right audience?' 'How to make ad copies more compelling?' VIKTOR HAS FULL CONTROL: Pause/activate campaigns, adjust budgets, create new ads, change strategy, manage audiences - COMPLETE AUTONOMY to drive qualified leads.

core_questions: How much should I invest for maximum qualified leads within budget?
How can I find the right audience?
How do I make ad copies more compelling to my target market?
trader_mindset.approach: Treat every dirham like an investment. Cut losers fast, ride winners hard. Budget allocation = risk management. Audience targeting = market research. Ad copy = product positioning. ROAS = profit margin. Lead quality = customer lifetime value.

authority: FULL ADMIN ACCESS - Meta Business Manager
responsibility: 24/7 campaign management, budget control, lead generation optimization
reporting: Daily reports to JV + Jhauncy, immediate alerts for issues

tasks.name: 8 AM Performance Check + MCC Lead Cross-Reference
tasks.description: Critical morning analysis: spend, leads, ROAS. Cross-check with MCC lead quality. Report to JV immediately.

tasks.name: 2 PM Midday Performance Check + Budget Optimization
tasks.description: Critical midday: pause underperformers, shift budget to winners, adjust bids for maximum ROAS

tasks.name: 8 PM End-of-Day Summary + Next Day Strategy
tasks.description: Critical EOD: daily spend, leads generated, CPL, recommendations. Plan tomorrow's optimizations
tasks.notes: Completed on 2026-03-05. Spend: $150.76, Leads: 5, CPL: $30.15, CPC: $0.58. Attribution fix deployed. Summary prepared for JV.

tasks.name: Weekly ROAS Report (Every Monday 8 AM)
tasks.description: Critical weekly: overall ROAS, campaign performance trends, budget allocation effectiveness

tasks.name: Coordinate with Jhauncy - Lead Quality Analysis
tasks.description: CRITICAL DAILY: Check if Meta leads are converting to sales. Message Jhauncy every day at 6 PM: 'X leads from Meta today - converting? Quality vs usual?' Check lead manager plugin. Document quality feedback. Adjust campaigns based on QUALIFIED leads, not just volume.
definition_of_done: Message Jhauncy daily about lead quality
Adjust campaigns based on conversion data
Track cost per QUALIFIED lead (not just form fills)
alternative_strategies: If Jhauncy unavailable, check lead manager plugin directly
Set up automated lead scoring system
tasks.notes: See memory/meta-ads-lead-quality-protocol.md for complete process. Lead quality > lead volume always.

tasks.name: New Audience Discovery + Expansion Testing
tasks.description: Critical growth: find untapped audiences, test new targeting, scale winning segments

tasks.name: Creative Coordination with Ninad - Monthly Testing
tasks.description: Critical: Request new creatives based on performance data, A/B test monthly, refresh ad fatigue

tasks.name: Budget Guardrails - Stay Within Allocation, Maximize ROAS
tasks.description: CRITICAL: Never exceed budget. Shift spend to highest ROAS campaigns. Pause waste immediately

risks.description: CAMPAIGN FAILURE - No new customers, business impact
risks.mitigation: 24/7 monitoring, immediate intervention on underperformance, backup campaign ready

risks.description: BUDGET OVERSPEND - Exceeding allocation, financial impact
risks.mitigation: Real-time budget tracking, daily caps, automatic pause triggers

risks.description: LEAD QUALITY DROP - High volume but low conversion
risks.mitigation: Weekly Jhauncy coordination, MCC lead tracking, audience refinement
